page_summary:
The Minority Report and Other Classic Stories is the canonical works record for PKD's short-story collection. It preserves a single archive manifestation and gives the work a stable bibliographic home. The preserved item here is The Minority Report and Other Classic Stories (Collected Stories of Philip K. Dick, Volume 4) (circa 1954–1964). The archive copy runs 403 pages.

Archive summary: The Minority Report and Other Classic Stories constitutes Volume 4 of The Collected Stories of Philip K.

Researchers can use this entry to trace publication context, later commentary, and relationships to other works.
